explanation: Computer, meaning a person who did calculations, was in use by the 1640s. William Whewell coined physicist only in 1840; people such as Newton were natural philosophers.

claims.text: 'Computer', meaning a person who calculates, was in English use by the 1640s at the latest.
William Whewell coined the word 'physicist' in 1840.
Before the word physicist, scientists such as Isaac Newton were called natural philosophers.
